# Version 4.150.8 (Unreleased)
> **Raster and texture corrections**

## Highlights

The next m150 servicing update corrects region construction, texture sampling and failed runtime-shader pipelines.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Safer region and shader construction** — Budgets region storage for subdivided conics and checks accumulation overflow. Failed runtime-shader stage construction no longer leaves unresolved branches executable in a partial Raster Pipeline. ([#5543](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5543), [#5633](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5633))
- **Texture uploads and subset edges** — Disables an unsupported GLES upload format for BGRA textures interpreted as RGBx, and preserves nearest-filtered texture subset clamps when sampling could reach neighboring texels. ([#5543](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5543))
